criterion.title: Heart Rate Service Subscription (BLE GATT)
criterion.given: A Bluetooth device is connected via Story 5-1 connection flow

then.item: Subscribe to Heart Rate Measurement characteristic (0x2A37)
Parse HR value from characteristic notification (handle different data formats per spec)
Update currentHR state on each notification
Log to console: [SensorBridge] HR: {value} bpm

criterion.technicalNotes: HR Measurement characteristic uses variable-length format. Bit 0 of flags byte indicates 8-bit (0) vs 16-bit (1) HR value. Handle both contact sensor and non-contact device flags.

criterion.title: Real-Time HR Display (<100ms Latency)
criterion.given: Sensor is connected and streaming HR data
criterion.when: HR notification received from BLE device

then.item: Update currentHR state within 100ms of notification
Display current HR in sensor settings area (e.g., heart icon 72 bpm)
Push HR value to rolling 60-second history buffer (hrHistory[])
Calculate and display rolling average if >10 samples available

criterion.performance: Use performance.mark() to measure notification-to-render latency. Target: P95 <100ms

criterion.title: Automatic Reconnection (3-second window)
criterion.when: BLE device disconnects unexpectedly (user didn't click disconnect)

then.item: Immediately show status: "Reconnecting..."
Attempt reconnection every 500ms for up to 3 seconds (6 attempts)
On reconnect success: Resume HR subscription, show toast "Reconnected to {deviceName}"
On reconnect failure after 3s: Show toast "Couldn't reconnect. Please reconnect manually."
Update status to "disconnected" and enable manual reconnect button

errorHandling.scenario: Couldn't reconnect. Move closer to your device.
Couldn't reconnect. Make sure your device is on.

criterion.title: Threshold Rule Engine
criterion.given: HR data is streaming and threshold is configured

then.item: Check threshold every 10 seconds (evaluate hrHistory buffer)
Rule triggers when: Average HR > threshold for 3 consecutive checks (30 seconds minimum)
On trigger: Emit SENSOR_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED event
Log to sensorEvents[]: { type: "THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED", timestamp, data: { hr, threshold } }
Show suggestion toast (see AC5)
Cooldown: After trigger, wait 5 minutes before re-triggering same rule
Show toast with message: "Heart rate elevated. Switch to Calm preset?"
Include two buttons: "Switch" (primary) | "Dismiss" (secondary)
Toast remains visible for 15 seconds or until user action
On "Switch": Call applyPreset('calm'), log event SUGGESTION_ACCEPTED
On "Dismiss": Log event SUGGESTION_DISMISSED, close toast
On timeout: Treat as dismissed, log SUGGESTION_TIMEOUT

accessibility.item: Toast announced to screen readers: "Heart rate elevated at {HR} bpm. Suggestion: Switch to Calm preset."
Keyboard focus moves to toast on appear

criterion.title: Session Event Logging
criterion.given: Sensor is connected during an active session
criterion.when: Sensor events occur (threshold exceeded, suggestion shown, accepted, dismissed)

then.item: Push to current session's sensorEvents[] array with timestamp, type, and data
Event types: THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED, SUGGESTION_SHOWN, SUGGESTION_ACCEPTED, SUGGESTION_DISMISSED, SUGGESTION_TIMEOUT
Data includes: hr, hrAvg, threshold, presetApplied (if applicable)
On session end: Calculate and store hrAvg, hrMax, hrMin, hrDelta from history buffer

criterion.title: Configurable Threshold Setting
criterion.given: User wants to customize HR threshold

then.item: Show "Heart Rate Threshold" setting in sensor settings section
Number input with range 60-120 BPM, step 5
Default value: 85 BPM
Persist to localStorage: mp3_8d_hr_threshold
Show helper text: "Alert when heart rate exceeds this for 30+ seconds"
Live update: Changing threshold immediately affects rule engine (no restart needed)

criterion.title: Sensor Simulator Mode
criterion.given: Developer or tester needs to test without physical sensor
criterion.when: URL parameter ?simulate_sensor=true is present OR localStorage flag set

then.item: Show "Start Simulation" button in sensor settings
On click: Generate simulated HR data stream with base HR 70 BPM +/- 5 random variation
"Stress event" every 60 seconds: Ramp HR to 95 BPM over 20 seconds
Configurable via console: window.setSensorSimulation({ baseHR, stressHR, stressInterval })
Simulated device appears as "Simulated Sensor" in device list
isSimulated flag set to true in sensor state
All rule engine and logging behavior functions identically to real sensor

doc.title: Architecture - mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: SensorRuleEngine monitors data stream, triggering recommendations when thresholds exceed user-defined ranges (e.g., HR > 85 bpm for 3 min). Emits SENSOR_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED event consumed by presets + UI to show suggestions.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sensor & Adaptive Loop
doc.section: Full Spec - Workflows, Data Models, APIs
doc.snippet: Defines SensorProvider, useSensorBridge hook API, error codes, data models for sensor_consent and extended session schema. Story 5-2 workflow sequence: BLE connect, HR subscription, history buffer, rule evaluation, threshold trigger, suggestion toast.

doc.title: Story 5.1: Capability Detection & Consent UI
doc.snippet: Prerequisite story implementing SensorProvider context, IndexedDB sensor_consent store, capability detection, consent modal. Pattern: single-file architecture in index.html, soft-delete for audit trails, 21 automated tests passing.

doc.title: Epics & Stories - mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: Story S5.2 acceptance: Connects to standard Heart Rate Service; handles reconnect <3s; rule engine triggers Calm suggestion when HR > user-defined threshold for 3 min; event logged in session record. KPI: sensor connection success >=85%.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sensor & Adaptive Loop
doc.snippet: HR update latency: <100ms. Reconnect time: <3s. Rule evaluation: <50ms. Memory footprint: <5MB for 60s HR history buffer + consent records.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sensor & Adaptive Loop
doc.snippet: Session record additions: hrAvg, hrMax, hrMin, hrDelta (all number|null), sensorEvents[] array with timestamp, type, and data object for context-specific information.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sensor & Adaptive Loop
doc.snippet: Error codes: BT_NOT_SUPPORTED, SERIAL_NOT_SUPPORTED, PERMISSION_DENIED, DEVICE_NOT_FOUND, CONNECTION_FAILED, DISCONNECTED, RECONNECT_TIMEOUT with user-facing messages.

constraints.constraint: Single-file architecture: All implementation in index.html (maintaining project convention)
No server-side components: All sensor processing runs client-side
Privacy-first: All biometric data stays in IndexedDB, never leaves device
HR update latency must be <100ms (P95) from BLE notification to UI update
Preset application via applyPreset() must complete in <20ms
Rule evaluation must complete in <50ms per 10-second tick
Reconnect attempts must complete within 3 seconds (6 attempts at 500ms)
Suggestion toast stays 15 seconds; 5-minute cooldown after trigger
Default threshold: 85 BPM, configurable range 60-120 BPM, step 5
Must provide simulator mode for CI/CD testing without physical hardware
Follow existing console log patterns: [SensorBridge] for sensor ops, [SensorRuleEngine] for threshold eval
Follow existing test patterns from tests/sensor-consent.test.js
Build on Story 5-1 SensorProvider and connection flow (status: review)
Integrate with Epic 3 applyPreset() for suggestion acceptance
Integrate with Epic 4 SessionLogger for sensorEvents[] logging

interface.name: Heart Rate Measurement Characteristic
interface.signature: UUID: 0x2A37, Flags byte + HR value (8 or 16 bit)
interface.notes: Bit 0 of flags = 0: 8-bit HR (byte 1). Bit 0 = 1: 16-bit HR (bytes 1-2 little endian).

interface.name: applyPreset
interface.notes: Applies preset parameters to audio graph. Used when user accepts suggestion toast.

interface.name: showToast
interface.notes: Displays toast notification with 5s auto-dismiss. Use for reconnection status and errors.

interface.name: sensorConsentApi
interface.notes: IndexedDB CRUD for consent records. Call recordConnection when reconnecting.

interface.name: SessionLogger
interface.notes: Extend to accept sensorEvents[] and HR summary stats on session end.

interface.name: SensorRuleEngine (to implement)
interface.signature: class SensorRuleEngine { constructor(options), start(), stop(), setThreshold(bpm), onThresholdExceeded(callback) }
interface.notes: New module: 10s evaluation interval, 3 consecutive checks, 5min cooldown, emits SENSOR_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED.

interface.name: Console API for Simulator
interface.notes: Development/testing API exposed on window object for manual sensor simulation.

tests.standards: Tests follow Jest-style patterns using Node.js assert module. Test files are in tests/ directory and run via npm test. Use fake-indexeddb for IndexedDB mocking. Pattern: runTest wrapper function with async/await, console log output with checkmark/X indicators. Tests grouped by category: capability detection, CRUD operations, integration flows. Story 5-1 established 21 passing tests as baseline.
